name: WHIST ROMANIAN
description: Romanian Whist is an exact-prediction trick-taking game for 3 to 6 players. Each player bids how many tricks they will take; the sum of all bids must not equal the number of cards dealt. Players score for making their contract exactly and lose points for over- or undertricks.

content.text: Romanian Whist is an exact-prediction trick-taking game for 3 to 6 players. Each player bids how many tricks they will take; the sum of all bids must not equal the number of cards dealt. Players score for making their contract exactly and lose points for over- or undertricks.
Romanian Whist is a regional exact-prediction trick game; known in Romania simply as Whist. Description contributed by Werner Hintze and others.
Three to six players, each playing alone (no partnerships). Best with 4 to 6.
Standard 52-card deck; 8 cards per player in use (24 for 3 players, 32 for 4, up to 48 for 6).

First dealer chosen at random; deal rotates clockwise. Number of cards per player varies by deal: starts at 1 card each for as many deals as players, increases by one per deal up to 8 each, then 8 each for as many deals as players, then decreases back to 1. Example with 4 players: 1,1,1,1, 2,3,4,5,6,7, 8,8,8,8, 7,6,5,4,3,2, 1,1,1,1 (24 deals). After the deal, the next card is turned for trump; in 8-card hands no card remains, so those hands are played without trumps.

items.text: 8-1-8 deal sequence: Begin and end with 8-card hands (8,8,8,8, then 7 down to 1, then back up to 8,8,8,8); reduces 1-card luck.
Blind 1-card: On 1-card deals everyone bids before looking at their card.
Forehead 1-card: Players hold 1-card on forehead; see others' cards, bid accordingly.
